bio: Conveniently located in the city centre, a stone's throw from the cathedral and the Rhine River, this is the second maiBeck restaurant. In a trendy and chic setting, Jan C Maier and Tobias Becker serve up modern Italian cuisine with a focus on fish and seafood, although vegetarian options are also available. The pasta dishes are highly recommended. In addition to the excellent à la carte selection, the six-course La Sera set menu is available in the evening. The wine list is exclusively Italian. The front-of-house team are dedicated and attentive – the chefs also help to serve the food....
